en.p: and a positive number $t$, let $g(t)$ be the value of $s$ such that the distance between the foot of the perpendicular from the point $(s,\,f(s))\ (s>0)$ to the $y$-axis and the point where the tangent line to the curve $y=f(x)$ at $(s,\,f(s))$ meets the $y$-axis is $t$. What is the value of $\displaystyle\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{27}{4}}g(t)\,dt$? [4 points]
